blind.description: A decorative classical urn or jar with a fitted lid. It features a round tiered pedestal foot, a baluster-shaped vessel body encircled by raised decorative horizontal bands and studded with rounded bronze bosses/rivets around the widest circumference, and a domed stepped lid crowned by a spherical ball finial. The material is polished bronze or copper with dark green verdigris patina filling the recessed grooves and decorative bands. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and structurally sound.
blind.from_above: A series of concentric circles radiating outward from the small spherical finial knob at the center, with subtle circular bumps (studs) protruding evenly around the outer edge, casting an elongated shadow upwards to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1 foot in diameter at its widest point.
